title: ZidaProject
subtitle: Implementation Readiness Questionnaire
tagline: Version 2.0 — focused on ZIDA’s technical environment for implementation and migration
meta: Chief Executive Officer, Zimbabwe Investment and Development Agency (ZIDA)
Confidential — for ZIDA and Afronovation use only
purpose: Thank you for your feedback on the first questionnaire. This simplified version focuses only on ZIDA. It asks what Afronovation needs to know to implement ZidaProject and move it from the pilot into ZIDA’s production environment, in support of ZIDA’s mandate and Zimbabwe’s digital agenda.
howTo: Most questions only need a tick. Type any details in the shaded boxes, then save the file.
“Not sure” is a perfectly good answer. We will work through open points together in a short workshop.
Please attach copies of the documents listed in the Attachments checklist, and return everything to Afronovation by the date above.

sections.title: Users and Content
sections.why: Tells us how large the platform needs to be.

questions.q: Approximately how many people will use the platform in its first year?
Approximately how many projects and documents will be loaded at launch?
Where is this project information kept today?
fields: If another system, please name it

sections.title: Hosting
sections.why: Determines where and how the platform will run, and its cost.

questions.q: Where are ZIDA’s website and IT systems hosted today?
options: A local hosting provider in Zimbabwe
A cloud service (e.g. Microsoft, Google, Amazon)

questions.q: Where would ZIDA prefer ZidaProject to be hosted?
options: Afronovation hosts and manages it in a secure cloud

questions.q: Must ZIDA’s data be stored inside Zimbabwe?
When does the platform need to be available?

sections.title: Email, Web Address and Sign-in
sections.why: Lets platform emails and staff logins work with ZIDA’s existing accounts.

questions.q: Which email service does ZIDA use?
Which web address should the platform use?
fields: Who manages ZIDA’s web address (domain) today?

questions.q: Should ZIDA staff sign in using their existing ZIDA work account?
options: No, a separate login is fine

sections.title: Connections and Processes
sections.why: Shows how ZidaProject fits with ZIDA’s other platforms and ways of working.

questions.q: Should ZidaProject connect with other ZIDA-owned platforms, or run independently?
options: Connect with other ZIDA platforms (name them below)
fields: Platforms to connect (e.g. ZIDA website, investment licensing, CRM)

questions.q: Which ZIDA processes should the platform support or reflect?
options: Reporting to management or the Board
questions.note: Please attach copies of the related process documents, forms, templates and scoring sheets.

sections.title: Team, Support and Go-Live
sections.why: Determines the support, training and handover ZIDA needs.

questions.q: How many people are in ZIDA’s IT team, and what do they look after?
Who should run the platform day to day?
options: Afronovation first, then hand over to ZIDA

questions.q: What support hours does ZIDA need?
How many ZIDA staff need training, and how?
Is there a target go-live date or event?

attachments.title: Attachments Checklist
attachments.intro: Please tick each document attached. Blank templates are enough; all documents are covered by the non-disclosure agreement between ZIDA and Afronovation.

nextSteps: ZIDA returns the completed questionnaire and attachments by the date above.
Afronovation and ZIDA hold a short workshop to clarify any open points.
Afronovation presents the implementation and migration plan, with costed options.
